status_definition: Pass requires valid hash-bound full reviews, fixed denominators, a passing queue provenance audit, and exact two-review agreement for every run. This audit does not adjudicate.

comparison_semantics.run_exact_match: Exact equality of the official decision fingerprint used by codex_manual_attack8_scoring.py.
comparison_semantics.false_positive_type: Compared as a diagnostic only; it is not part of the official decision fingerprint and does not create a review3 conflict.

pid_non_scoring_policy_ambiguity.potentially_affected_unit_definition: All subject Gold-item and subject candidate-slot judgment values in both reviews; this is a possibility flag, not a finding that any individual score is wrong.

action_vs_operation_vocabulary.potentially_affected_unit_definition: All operation-labeled candidate-slot judgments, and corresponding Gold operation-item judgments, in both reviews; this is a possibility flag, not a finding that any individual score is wrong.

review3_conflict_queue.note: Rows are an exact ordered subset of review_queue.jsonl. Potential policy-impact flags are recorded in this audit, not in the conflict queue, to preserve the source queue contracts.
